description: Mixed: greets and closes with branding, uses name, resolves issue, but blunt at times, no verification, re-asks info already given (weak active listening).
transcript:
[00:00] Client: Hi, my email on my S-NET account isn't sending. My name is Rita.
[00:06] Agent: Thank you for calling S-NET Communications, my name is Marcus. What seems to be the problem?
[00:12] Client: Like I said, my email won't send.
[00:16] Agent: Okay. And what's your name?
[00:19] Client: It's Rita, I just told you.
[00:22] Agent: Right. Let me check the mail server settings.
[00:30] Agent: The outgoing server port was set wrong. I've corrected it. Try sending now.
[00:50] Client: Okay... yes, it sent!
[00:54] Agent: Good, that's fixed then, Rita.
[00:58] Client: Thanks.
[01:01] Agent: Thank you for Choosing S-NET, bye.
